title: Make the child ignoreCase status pin observable on case-insensitive test hosts
outcome: The child status case-folding pin has a direct regression witness on case-insensitive hosts, or its existing counterexample is explicitly evidenced on a case-sensitive host, without confusing conservative rename refusal with proof of the pin.
acceptance: A recorded test result proves the core.ignoreCase=false status pin is exercised: either protected status exposes a renamed case variant that raw local-true status hides on an insensitive host, or the existing arbitrary-untracked-variant counterexample executes on a case-sensitive host.
The evidence records the actual host/capability and any UNVERIFIED controls; a positive or rename refusal that passes without the pin is not claimed as pin-removal sensitivity.
